thread:
Alex K.: Heads-up — planning rollout of API/SDK v2.1 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need someone to own the deploy, smoke checks list, and rollback plan. Any breaking changes to call out for clients? cc @Mira R., @Sam T. :eyes:

Mira R.: I can own the deploy. Plan: canary 10% for first 30m, then ramp to 50% for 30m, then full. Will run smoke checklist during canary. :thumbsup:

Sam T.: SDK release: 2.1.0. Mostly additive — new streaming param and minor rename: `timeout_ms` -> `timeout`. We keep `timeout_ms` as an alias for one release but will deprecate in 3 months. We'll include migration snippet in changelog.

Alex K.: Good — note that rename is the only compatibility risk. Mira, please verify alias behavior in canary.

Mira R.: Will do. Quick smoke checklist I'm going to run:
- `GET /health`
- `POST /v1/generate` with small prompt (sync + stream)
- embeddings sanity check for a known vector
- rate-limit header sanity
- auth token test (expired token -> 401)
I'll paste the smoke commands to the deploy thread before starting.

ops-oncall: Add ops notes: rollback command is `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-api -n prod --to-revision=<rev>` and redeploy tag `redwood-api:v2.0.9` kept pinned. Also keep last stable image in `stable` tag for quick re-deploy. No DB migrations in this release.

Julia P.: Docs / comms: I'll draft release notes and migration snippet now. Plan to put a console banner 24h before, and an in-app banner + email to active customers 1h before go-live. I'll post the draft here for review.

Sam T.: Quick compatibility note for SDK users: if you use `timeout_ms` it still works, but please switch to `timeout` which accepts seconds or `1.5s`. Example: `client.generate({ timeout: "1.5s" })`. We'll add lint warning in SDK v3.0 prep.

Mira R.: Running a canary smoke now in staging (not prod) to validate alias and streaming. Output looks okay so far. Will switch to prod canary at 09:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline triggered: pipeline/rollout-v2.1 by Mira R. — canary 10% scheduled for 2026-05-10T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Logs will be posted to #eng-platform/deploys.

Alex K.: Support plan: I'll ping @support to have 2 people on standby from 09:00–11:00 PT. Also notify partners who are on Dedicated.

Julia P.: Changelog draft: short summary, breaking note about `timeout_ms` rename + snippet, code migration example, and upgrade path. Will attach PR link in ~15m.

Mira R.: Small gotcha: one internal client uses raw `timeout_ms` integer. I've run compatibility test, alias works but behavior differs when value = 0 (infinite). We'll treat 0 as special-case and preserve current behavior. Adding to smoke checklist.

Sam T.: Good catch — will add test in SDK CI to cover `0` case.

ops-oncall: Monitoring hooks: enable `response_time` and `error_rate` alerts with 5m window during canary. If error_rate > 1% sustained for 10m, auto-roll back.

Alex K.: Final: Mira will start at 09:00 PT. Mira, confirm in this thread when canary starts and when you promote to full. I'll coordinate support and comms. Thanks team. :rocket:
